home.eyebrow: Real estate developer — Paris · Cannes · Miami
home.sub: CARVER INVEST sources, renovates and resells high-potential properties between Paris, the French Riviera and Miami — with an investor's discipline and a craftsman's standards.
home.citiesSub: Every market has its own logic. Our approach stays the same: source carefully, renovate with rigor, sell at the right time.
home.cityParisText: Haussmannian apartments and character properties in the most sought-after districts and surrounding towns.
home.cityCannesText: Villas and estates between Cannes, Mouans-Sartoux and Mandelieu-la-Napoule, in a market driven by international demand.
home.cityMiamiText: Residences and villas across Greater Miami, at the crossroads of North American, Latin American and European investors.

about.title: The firm
about.intro: CARVER INVEST is an independent real estate developer active in Paris, on the French Riviera and in Miami.
about.body1: Our work is to identify high-potential properties — off-market, undervalued or under-utilized — and transform them with rigor before bringing them back to market.
about.body2: We operate across three markets with different dynamics, following one shared method: a disciplined analysis of every deal, demanding site supervision, and a sharp read on the right time to sell.
about.step1Text: Identifying high-potential properties, off-market or undervalued, in targeted areas.
about.step2Text: Structuring the deal, negotiating and securing the purchase.
about.step3Text: Overseeing the works with partner architects and craftsmen, down to the smallest detail.
about.step4Text: Positioning and bringing the transformed property to market at the right time.

invest.intro: Select CARVER INVEST operations are open to private investors, through co-investment or dedicated financing.
invest.body1: Every operation is documented: deal size, projected timeline, guarantees. We speak with each potential investor before any formal proposal.
invest.body2: Whether you're an individual investor or want to explore a partnership on a specific project, let's talk.
